self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1096 is design-only. It inherits the matched-current wrong-history proof-surface scope and cannot upgrade to anticipatory self-identification.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1096 does not run scenarios or add a pre-emergency warm-up window. It only designs conversion for existing M1092 rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a family-aggregate conversion contract is unsafe, route to source-specific replay gating or new surface mining rather than weakening source-diversity or compactability criteria.

no driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level generalization claim

hypothesis: A family-aggregate raw-retained conversion contract can preserve the M1092 source-balanced surface while making source-policy metadata, duplicate geometry, replay sanity, and hidden-state handling explicit.
success_criteria: raw-retained duplicate geometry semantics are explicit
replay sanity requirements are explicit and precede objective optimization
hidden-state/source-policy mixing is handled or explicitly avoided
no training, PPO, replay, mining, promotion, or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: source-policy or duplicate-geometry contract is ambiguous
training, PPO, replay, mining, promotion, or private holdout starts
decision_rule: M1096 may only design the family-aggregate raw-retained conversion contract. It cannot train, run PPO, run replay, mine rows, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or weaken M1092 thresholds.
